title: Gocaro
text: 1-3 Sāvatthi || || Cattāro me bhikkhave jhāyī || || Katame cattāro || || 4 Idha bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo || 5 Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo || || [page 267] XXIV. 8. 6] JHĀNA-SAṂYUTTA 267 6 Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī neva samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo || || 7 Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti samādhismim gocarakusalo ca || || 8 Tatra bhikkhave yvāyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo ca || ayam imesaṃ catunnam jhāyīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca mokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca || || 9 Seyyathāpi bhikkhave gavā khīraṃ || pe || pavaro cāti || ||
